svg.aria-label: ADR-004: results are read on a Pareto frontier over declared axes, never as a scalar; the perplexity guard is a floor; a candidate advances when it extends the frontier; the linked decision D17 makes the frontier the public object and the recipe the private workshop, the public switch gated on the dissociation measured on the model
svg.title: ADR-004 — The evaluation law: a Pareto frontier over declared axes, never a scalar; and what is published
svg.text: The evaluation law: a frontier over declared axes, never a scalar; the frontier is what is published
quantum-cortex, original figure for ADR-004. Features are not additive, the composition addressed varies, quality and efficiency are different axes: a single number hides all three.
Decision two: Pareto, not ranking
one declared capability axis (the continuity triad, the per wave benchmarks)
one declared efficiency axis (per parameter, per bit)
the frontier: each committed
record is a point; no point on
it beats another on every axis
the control: the lower left corner,
organ free, a reference, not a capability result
a loss: published, it did
not move the frontier
advances: strictly better on at least one declared axis
without regressing another beyond the guard: the frontier moves
no composite score is ever computed or published; a headline names the axis it refers to
the perplexity guard
a floor a candidate clears
to be considered; not an axis
Decision one: the declared axes, a frozen set

g.text: capability: the continuity triad, episodic persistence, revision under an oracle shift,
non regeneration of the known; plus the declared per wave benchmarks
efficiency: capability per parameter and per bit; latency, energy and cost recorded as secondary signals
the perplexity guard is a guard, not an axis: a floor a candidate clears to be considered,
never what makes it better; no composite score is ever computed or published;
a change of the set is a dated amendment, never a silent add or drop

svg.text: Decisions three and four: the corollaries, all testable, all recorded; honest credit

g.text: two regimes: organs are ablated in isolation to understand, the validated combination
is retrained as one to decide; non additivity is expected, not a surprise
interaction is declared data: the measured joint effect is recorded next to the sum
of the isolated effects; synergy and interference are ledger entries, not anecdotes
composition provenance: each record notes the composition that produced it,
the what of the context, not only the how much
honest credit: multi objective optimisation is an established field; what is ours is its application
to the continuity triad; the record claims a discipline, not an invention

svg.text: The linked decision: what we measure on a frontier is what we show, and only that

g.text: The frontier is the public object
the ledger, the benchmarks, the schema,
a README stating the thesis; the recipe
stays the private workshop until the
founder decides otherwise, reversibly
The switch has one gate
the Molaison dissociation must pass on the
language model, with the reserves stated;
the organ's own pass does not qualify;
a fail is a result and keeps the repository private
The condition read on the record
met by the system, the model deciding
and the organ answering, on live seeds
that did not conceive the policy; never
as a pass of the model alone
Only the cortex goes public
a filtered copy of this repository:
same commits, same dates; the working
files on how the author works removed
from every commit; the hub's two governing
pages mirrored; the secret sweep a condition
the law and a candidate under it
the frontier and what is public
the guard, outside the axes
what is recorded
